verdict: It's a tie. Both are good snacks for weight loss. Choose based on your taste and timing.
why: Calories are almost the same: banana about 100 kcal, apple about 90 kcal.
Protein and fat are both almost zero, so they're less filling eaten on their own.
Both are hard to overeat. Rarely does anyone eat 4 at once.
An apple needs more chewing, and many people feel more satisfied. A banana is easy to carry and gives quick energy.
when_a: Banana is okay before exercise, or when you need a quick snack at the office or in the car.
when_b: Apple is okay when you want an afternoon snack that takes longer to eat and lasts longer in your mouth.
tip: Pair fruit with a protein source, for example a boiled egg or a glass of milk, so you stay full longer.

faq.q: Bananas are high in sugar, should I avoid them?
faq.a: No need. One banana is only about 100 kcal and has fibre. The natural sugar in fruit can fit into your diet.
Not recommended. Fruit is low in protein, so you get hungry quickly and may overeat later. Have fruit as a snack or dessert.
